messages:
maya_cs: Hey team — Renewal for TidalHealth is stuck in legal review. Legal asked for a signer authorization doc before esign. Can we confirm who signs on the customer side?
jonah_am: Customer said today that procurement needs a delegated signer from their finance org (CFO out on PTO). They offered their Head of RevOps to sign.
maya_cs: Do we accept delegated signers for annual commits? Any internal constraints?
priya_legal: We can accept delegation but need a scanned letter on company letterhead + match to billing entity in the SOW. Also need to verify the delegating exec email chain.
sam_finance: Also need PO to reference the exact billing entity and net30 terms. If the signer's org differs, we need renewed invoice entity or intercompany memo.
maya_cs: Got it. Jonah, can you ask them for a delegation letter and the Head of RevOps' corporate email? Provide sample language.
jonah_am: Sent message to client at 12:06 — included this template: "I, <Name>, Head of Revenue Operations, am authorized by <CFO Name> to sign the contract for <Billing Entity> on their behalf. Attached is the Exec approval email from <CFO Name>." — waiting reply. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
priya_legal: Thanks — once we have that letter + exec email chain we can approve. Also, we'll need the signer's full legal name and title for the signature block.
dana_ops_bot: Document checklist updated: delegation_letter (pending), exec_email_thread (pending), PO_reference (pending), billing_entity_match (pending).
maya_cs: Small wrinkle — client requested 9mo term instead of 12mo to match fiscal year. That changes proration. Sam, any blockers accepting 9mo?
sam_finance: We can do 9mo pro-rated invoice. Need to confirm prorate calculation: full annual commit $120k => 9mo charge $90k. Also confirm they still want net30.
jonah_am: Client confirmed Head of RevOps will send letter today and they accept pro-rate. They asked if we can route docs via DocuSign to their procurement alias procurement@tidalhealth.com.
priya_legal: DocuSign routing to procurement alias is fine but signature authority must be from the delegate. We'll add signatory verification step in the SOW appendix.
maya_cs: Perfect. Once delegation letter + PO reference + billing entity doc arrive, I'll attach and route to legal for sign-off and to finance for invoice prep.
jonah_am: Received delegation letter PDF 12:48 — forwarding now.
dana_ops_bot: delegation_letter (received), exec_email_thread (pending), PO_reference (pending), billing_entity_match (pending)
priya_legal: Reviewing letter now. Looks valid but need the CFO approval email chain too (one-line confirmation from CFO is fine).
maya_cs: Jonah — can you ask for the CFO email? Also ask procurement to provide PO number referencing billing entity.
jonah_am: On it. Follow-up sent to procurement and the Head of RevOps.
maya_cs: Thanks — will hold renewal for sign-off. If anything blocks more than 48hrs escalate to AM leadership. :phone_receiver:
